title: Detailed popsicle
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Stick -->
  <rect x='44' y='68' width='12' height='28' rx='3' fill='#D4A96A'/>
  <rect x='44' y='68' width='12' height='4' rx='2' fill='#E8C48A'/>
  <rect x='47' y='72' width='2' height='20' rx='1' fill='#C49A5C'/>
  <rect x='52' y='72' width='2' height='20' rx='1' fill='#C49A5C'/>

  <!-- Popsicle body - main orange -->
  <rect x='22' y='18' width='56' height='56' rx='14' fill='#FF7A3D'/>
  
  <!-- Lighter top face -->
  <rect x='22' y='18' width='56' height='56' rx='14' fill='#FF9055' opacity='0.6'/>
  
  <!-- Top rounded highlight -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='30' rx='22' ry='12' fill='#FFB080' opacity='0.7'/>
  
  <!-- Bottom curve shade -->
  <rect x='24' y='58' width='52' height='16' rx='10' fill='#E8652E' opacity='0.8'/>

  <!-- Drip details on left side -->
  <ellipse cx='26' cy='45' rx='6' ry='8' fill='#FF9055'/>
  <ellipse cx='26' cy='45' rx='3' ry='5' fill='#FFB080' opacity='0.7'/>
  
  <!-- Drip detail on right side -->
  <ellipse cx='74' cy='50' rx='5' ry='7' fill='#FF9055'/>
  <ellipse cx='74' cy='50' rx='2.5' ry='4' fill='#FFB080' opacity='0.7'/>
  
  <!-- Small drip bottom left -->
  <ellipse cx='30' cy='70' rx='4' ry='5' fill='#FF9055'/>
  
  <!-- Small drip bottom right -->
  <ellipse cx='70' cy='68' rx='3' ry='4' fill='#FF9055'/>

  <!-- Shine highlight top left -->
  <ellipse cx='36' cy='30' rx='8' ry='12' fill='#FFD4B0' opacity='0.5' transform='rotate(-15 36 30)'/>
  
  <!-- Small shine dot -->
  <ellipse cx='34' cy='28' rx='3' ry='5' fill='#FFE8D6' opacity='0.7' transform='rotate(-15 34 28)'/>

  <!-- Front detail - horizontal lines suggesting texture -->
  <rect x='30' y='36' width='40' height='2' rx='1' fill='#E8652E' opacity='0.5'/>
  <rect x='28' y='42' width='44' height='2' rx='1' fill='#E8652E' opacity='0.4'/>
  
  <!-- Vertical center line detail -->
  <rect x='49' y='32' width='2' height='30' rx='1' fill='#E8652E' opacity='0.3'/>

  <!-- Frost/sugar sparkle dots -->
  <circle cx='38' cy='52' r='1.5' fill='#FFE8D6' opacity='0.8'/>
  <circle cx='56' cy='46' r='1.5' fill='#FFE8D6' opacity='0.8'/>
  <circle cx='62' cy='58' r='1.2' fill='#FFE8D6' opacity='0.7'/>
  <circle cx='44' cy='62' r='1' fill='#FFE8D6' opacity='0.7'/>
  <circle cx='35' cy='42' r='1' fill='#FFE8D6' opacity='0.6'/>

  <!-- Top edge smooth curve lighter -->
  <path d='M30 20 Q50 12 70 20' stroke='#FFC4A0' stroke-width='2' fill='none' opacity='0.6'/>
</svg>
